title: Zoom+
description: This mod allows you to be able to zoom without a spyglass if you hold c on your keyboard it will zoom in you can use scroll wheel to adjust the zoom the keybind is changable in your settings.
body: This mod allows you to zoom without a spyglass. If you hold C on your keyboard, it will zoom in; you can then use the scroll wheel to adjust the zoom level. The keybind is also completely changeable in your settings.
